استحجبا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْجَبَا (istaḥjabā) /is.taħ.d͡ʒa.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# اُسْتُحْجِبَا (ustuḥjibā) /us.tuħ.d͡ʒi.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# اِسْتَحْجِبَا (istaḥjibā) /is.taħ.d͡ʒi.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
